Recovery-typed PRESENT while INACTIVE now has exactly one applicable recovery-staging member in UNBOOTSTRAPPED/EXPIRED/STALE/QUORUM, while the ordinary member yields no branch. In TRUSTED, the ordinary member is inapplicable and no recovery member exists, so PAYLOAD-NOT-ADMISSIBLE is the sole outcome. All 51 atomic v7-to-v8 changes are inside the closed roster, and no authority claim appears. One provenance advisory remains: the Codex v7 verdict froze after v8 authoring and confirms exactly SITCV7-S1, but v8 still records it only as an unpinned provisional.
